# RIGHT NOW: your robots.txt is Cloudflare's auto-generated "Managed
# content" block. It contains "Allow: /" for Googlebot (fine) BUT it
# also Disallows: GPTBot, ClaudeBot, CCBot, Google-Extended,
# Amazonbot, Applebot-Extended, meta-externalagent.
#
# Those are the crawlers behind ChatGPT search, Claude, Perplexity and
# AI Overviews grounding. If you want to be recommended when someone
# asks "best custom t-shirt manufacturer in Dubai", you need them in.
#
# HOW TO APPLY: Cloudflare Dashboard -> your zone -> Settings (or
# "Rules" on the new UI) -> Robots.txt -> switch OFF "Managed robots.txt"
# / AI Crawl Control, then serve this file from public/robots.txt.
# ===================================================================
